<!--
================================================================================
  GOAL
  ----
  Load the cached bootstrap stability results for all four clustering methods
  (K-Means, RKM, PD, FPDC) and produce a set of comparison plots:

    Plot 1 — All four methods on one panel per embedding (line plot of mean ARI)
    Plot 2 — Faceted by method, all embeddings overlaid (colour = embedding)
    Plot 3 — Heatmap of mean ARI across (method × embedding × k)
    Plot 4 — Boxplots of per-replicate ARI distributions by method
    Plot 5 — Reference silhouette vs. bootstrap ARI scatter (method quality)

  All data come from previously saved .rds bootstrap cache files.
  No clustering models are re-fitted here.
================================================================================
-->

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo    = TRUE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.width  = 10,
  fig.height = 6,
  dpi = 150
)
```

# 1. Requirements

```{r requirements}
required_packages <- c("dplyr", "tidyr", "ggplot2", "readr", "patchwork")

installed    <- rownames(installed.packages())
missing_pkgs <- setdiff(required_packages, installed)
if (length(missing_pkgs) > 0) install.packages(missing_pkgs)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(patchwork)
```

# 2. Settings

```{r settings}
# ── Cache directories ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
boot_cache_dir <- "output/bootstrap_stability_cache"

# ── Experiment grid ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
embedding_tags <- c("user_embeddings_64", "user_embeddings_128", "user_embeddings_256")
k_values       <- c(2, 3, 4)
methods        <- c("KMeans", "RKM", "PD", "FPDC")

# ── Shared aesthetics ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
method_colors <- c(
  KMeans = "#E07B54",
  RKM    = "#5B8DB8",
  PD     = "#4DB8A4",
  FPDC   = "#A67BB5"
)

embedding_labels <- c(
  user_embeddings_64  = "64-dimensional",
  user_embeddings_128 = "128-dimensional",
  user_embeddings_256 = "256-dimensional"
)

base_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position  = "bottom"
  )
```

# 3. Load cached bootstrap results

```{r load-cache}
# ── Helper: load one (method, embedding, k) cache file ───────────────────────
load_boot_cache <- function(method, embedding_tag, k_val,
                            cache_dir = boot_cache_dir) {
  prefix <- switch(method,
    KMeans = "bootstrap_kmeans",
    RKM    = "bootstrap_rkm",
    PD     = "bootstrap_pd",
    FPDC   = "bootstrap_fpdc"
  )

  fpath <- file.path(cache_dir,
                     paste0(prefix, "_", embedding_tag, "_k", k_val, ".rds"))

  if (!file.exists(fpath)) return(NULL)

  obj <- readRDS(fpath)

  # Extract the ARI vector — field name differs by method
  ari_vec <- switch(method,
    KMeans = obj$kmeans_boot_ari,
    RKM    = obj$rkm_boot_ari,
    PD     = obj$pd_boot_ari,
    FPDC   = obj$fpdc_boot_ari
  )

  # Extract reference silhouette — field name differs by method
  ref_sil <- switch(method,
    KMeans = obj$kmeans_reference_silhouette,
    RKM    = obj$rkm_reference_silhouette,
    PD     = obj$pd_reference_silhouette,
    FPDC   = obj$fpdc_reference_silhouette
  )

  data.frame(
    method        = method,
    embedding     = embedding_tag,
    k             = k_val,
    replicate     = seq_along(ari_vec),
    ari           = ari_vec,
    ref_silhouette = if (length(ref_sil) == 1) ref_sil else NA_real_,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# ── Load all combinations ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
all_replicates <- bind_rows(lapply(methods, function(m) {
  bind_rows(lapply(embedding_tags, function(e) {
    bind_rows(lapply(k_values, function(k) {
      load_boot_cache(m, e, k)
    }))
  }))
})) %>%
  mutate(
    method    = factor(method,    levels = methods),
    embedding = factor(embedding, levels = embedding_tags,
                       labels = embedding_labels),
    k         = as.integer(k)
  )

# ── Summary: mean ± SD per (method, embedding, k) ────────────────────────────
summary_df <- all_replicates %>%
  group_by(method, embedding, k) %>%
  summarise(
    ari_mean   = mean(ari,  na.rm = TRUE),
    ari_sd     = sd(ari,    na.rm = TRUE),
    ari_median = median(ari, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_valid    = sum(is.finite(ari)),
    ref_sil    = first(ref_silhouette),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("Loaded", nrow(all_replicates), "replicate rows across",
    n_distinct(all_replicates$method), "methods,",
    n_distinct(all_replicates$embedding), "embeddings,",
    n_distinct(all_replicates$k), "k values.\n")
```

# 4. Plot 1 — All methods on one plot, faceted by embedding

```{r plot1-all-methods}
# One panel per embedding dimension.
# Lines connect k values; colour distinguishes method.
# Error bars show ± 1 SD across bootstrap replicates.

p1 <- ggplot(summary_df,
             aes(x = k, y = ari_mean,
                 colour = method, group = method)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
             colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = ari_mean - ari_sd,
        ymax = ari_mean + ari_sd),
    width = 0.15, alpha = 0.4, linewidth = 0.6,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1,
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5,
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) +
  facet_wrap(~ embedding, nrow = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = k_values) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = method_colors, name = "Method") +
  labs(
    title = "Bootstrap Stability: All Methods by Embedding Dimension",
    x     = "Number of clusters (k)",
    y     = "Mean bootstrap ARI (± 1 SD)"
  ) +
  base_theme

p1

ggsave("figures/stability_all_methods_by_embedding.png", p1,
       width = 11, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

# 5. Plot 2 — Faceted by method, embeddings overlaid

```{r plot2-by-method}
# One panel per method.
# Lines connect k values; colour distinguishes embedding dimension.
# Allows within-method comparison across embedding sizes.

embedding_colors <- c(
  "64-dimensional"  = "#F4A261",
  "128-dimensional" = "#2A9D8F",
  "256-dimensional" = "#457B9D"
)

p2 <- ggplot(summary_df,
             aes(x = k, y = ari_mean,
                 colour = embedding, group = embedding)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
             colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = ari_mean - ari_sd,
        ymax = ari_mean + ari_sd),
    width = 0.15, alpha = 0.4, linewidth = 0.6,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1,
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5,
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) +
  facet_wrap(~ method, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = k_values) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = embedding_colors, name = "Embedding") +
  labs(
    title = "Bootstrap Stability: All Embeddings by Method",
    x     = "Number of clusters (k)",
    y     = "Mean bootstrap ARI (± 1 SD)"
  ) +
  base_theme

p2

ggsave("figures/stability_all_embeddings_by_method.png", p2,
       width = 13, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

# 6. Plot 3 — Heatmap of mean ARI across all (method × embedding × k)

```{r plot3-heatmap}
# Each cell shows the mean bootstrap ARI.
# Rows = method × k combinations; columns = embedding dimension.
# Makes it easy to spot which cells are strong vs. near-zero.

heatmap_df <- summary_df %>%
  mutate(
    method_k = paste0(method, "  k=", k),
    method_k = factor(method_k,
                      levels = rev(paste0(
                        rep(methods, each = length(k_values)),
                        "  k=",
                        rep(k_values, times = length(methods))
                      )))
  )

p3 <- ggplot(heatmap_df,
             aes(x = embedding, y = method_k, fill = ari_mean)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", ari_mean)),
            size = 3, colour = "white", fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low      = "#C0392B",
    mid      = "#F5CBA7",
    high     = "#1A5276",
    midpoint = 0,
    name     = "Mean ARI",
    limits   = c(
      min(heatmap_df$ari_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
      max(heatmap_df$ari_mean, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Mean Bootstrap ARI Heatmap",
    x     = "Embedding dimension",
    y     = "Method and k"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid   = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

p3

ggsave("figures/stability_heatmap.png", p3,
       width = 9, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```

# 7. Plot 4 — Boxplots of per-replicate ARI by method

```{r plot4-boxplots}
# Shows the full distribution of ARI values across replicates,
# not just the mean. One panel per embedding.
# Reveals whether instability comes from high variance or low mean.

p4 <- ggplot(all_replicates,
             aes(x = factor(k), y = ari, fill = method)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
             colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_boxplot(
    outlier.size  = 0.8,
    outlier.alpha = 0.5,
    alpha         = 0.75,
    linewidth     = 0.4,
    position      = position_dodge(width = 0.85)
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ embedding, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = method_colors, name = "Method") +
  labs(
    title = "Bootstrap ARI Distributions by Method, Embedding, and k",
    x     = "Number of clusters (k)",
    y     = "Bootstrap ARI"
  ) +
  base_theme

p4

ggsave("figures/stability_boxplots.png", p4,
       width = 13, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

# 8. Plot 5 — Reference silhouette vs. mean bootstrap ARI

```{r plot5-sil-vs-ari}
# Scatter plot: x = reference (full-data) silhouette width,
#               y = mean bootstrap ARI.
# Each point is one (method, embedding, k) combination.
# A method in the top-right quadrant is both internally valid
# and stable — the ideal outcome.

p5 <- ggplot(summary_df,
             aes(x = ref_sil, y = ari_mean,
                 colour = method, shape = embedding)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
             colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
             colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = method_colors, name = "Method") +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c("64-dimensional" = 16, "128-dimensional" = 17,
               "256-dimensional" = 15),
    name = "Embedding"
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "Internal Validity vs. Bootstrap Stability",
    subtitle = "Top-right = strong silhouette and stable partition",
    x        = "Reference silhouette width (full-data solution)",
    y        = "Mean bootstrap ARI"
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

p5

ggsave("figures/stability_sil_vs_ari.png", p5,
       width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

# 9. Summary table

```{r summary-table}
summary_wide <- summary_df %>%
  select(method, embedding, k, ari_mean, ari_sd, ari_median, n_valid, ref_sil) %>%
  arrange(method, embedding, k)

knitr::kable(
  summary_wide,
  digits  = 3,
  col.names = c("Method", "Embedding", "k",
                "Mean ARI", "SD ARI", "Median ARI",
                "Valid reps", "Ref. silhouette"),
  caption = "Bootstrap stability summary across all methods, embeddings, and k values."
)

write.csv(
  summary_wide,
  file      = "output/bootstrap_stability_results/bootstrap_stability_all_methods_summary.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  all_replicates,
  file      = "output/bootstrap_stability_results/bootstrap_stability_all_methods_replicates.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
